purpose: Upstream commits that npm run check:drift last found matching the specs. Only check:drift --record writes them, and only when every checked value matches.

repositories.name: clementina-mia
repositories.role: physical MIA firmware; register/RAM protocols and hardware implementation
repositories.checks: C headers under src/mia (plus sd.c's SD pins and the *_configure_index reset defaults): commands, errors, status and IRQ bits, config fields, index ids and defaults, RAM blocks, GPIO pins, and the machine, video, audio, input and storage values they define

repositories.name: clementina-rom
repositories.role: 6502 kernel/BASIC/WozMon; kernel ABI and programmer-facing memory map
repositories.checks: a cc65 build's kernel.dbg, kernel.lbl and kernel.bin: the jump table, image bounds, named CPU locations, VIA registers, BASIC token tables and debugger addresses, and the ROM's copies of MIA registers, ids, bits and opcodes that use the spec's or MIA's names, plus its committed src/include/mia.inc, which must equal the generated one

sourcePrecedence: Physical MIA register/RAM behavior: clementina-mia source, unless explicitly recorded as unresolved.
Kernel ABI and current ROM memory use: clementina-rom.
Rendering semantics: clementina-mia video spec cross-checked with clementina-video-client.
Authoring semantics: clementina-studio, constrained by hardware specs.
